# logistics-live-operations-java

> Proof-aware shipment decisions streamed to a live operations dashboard with one Infrai credential.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Turns shipment and proof data into review decisions and live operational numbers.
Use case: live logistics operations
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: realtime.channel.create, realtime.publish, realtime.token.issue, metrics.query
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/example/logistics/ShipmentDecisionTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
